test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Consider three points P, Q and S at distances r, 2r and 3r from a straight conductor carrying current I.

Which of the following relations is true about the magnitude of the magnetic fields BP, BQ and BS at points P, Q and S, respectively?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BP > BQ > BS**__.
